opportunities.name: Tech lead research (HN + GitHub -> note)
opportunities.description: For a given project name, find its top Hacker News story and GitHub repo stats, then save a 'Lead' note with HN title/points/age and GitHub stars/last release.
steps: Search the project name on Hacker News (Algolia) and note top story title, points and age
Open GitHub, search the project name, open the top repo
Read stars and latest release date
Open notes app, create new note 'Lead: <project>. HN ... ; GitHub ... stars, last release ...'

opportunities.description: Search a country name in World Bank Data search box to open its country data page.
steps: Go to World Bank data home

opportunities.name: Country fact-check: World Bank + BBC news -> note
opportunities.description: For a country, look up a World Bank indicator and a related BBC news story, then save a fact-check note.
steps: Search country on World Bank and read indicator (e.g. life expectancy)
Search BBC for '<country> <topic>' and open top article
Add note with indicator value and headline context
